name: Shinjin 22-sai no Onee-chan Ura Mono AV Debut!! Saitou Hanako
original_name: 新人22歳のお姉ちゃん裏モノAVデビュー!! 斎藤花子
source:
Saito Hanako is a talented woman attending a prestigious university. Even from the perspective of me, her younger brother, she is beautiful and has a great personality. She is the kind of sister one can proudly show off anywhere.


Secretly, I have been harboring a deep yearning for my sister. Well, to be honest, it's more like an obsession—I've been using her as material for my masturbation fantasies. One day, my sister dropped a bombshell.


"I have to repay my ex-boyfriend's debt, it's 5 million yen."


My sister had been deceived and abandoned by her ex-boyfriend. Honestly, it was the most despairing news I had heard in recent years. If things had come to this, there was no choice but for the two of us to film a private adult video and use the money to repay the debt!


"What? I'd rather die than have sex with my brother!"


So, I had no choice but to involve my friend, Kaneda, a socially awkward virgin, as the male performer. But little did I know, he was in possession of a truly massive package!


...And so, this is the tragic tale of a sorrowful younger brother who must film his sister being ravished by his friend, all for the sake of repaying a debt.
translation:
斋藤花子是一位就读名牌大学的才女。即便从身为弟弟的我来看，她也美丽、性格好，是无论到哪里都值得骄傲的姐姐。

我暗中一直对姐姐怀着深切的憧憬。好吧，说实话，更像是一种执念，我一直将她当作自慰幻想的对象。某天，姐姐却抛出了一个惊人消息。

“我得替前男友还债，一共五百万日元。”

姐姐被前男友骗了，还遭到抛弃。说实话，这是我近几年听过最绝望的消息。既然如此，就只能由我们两人拍摄私人AV片，用赚来的钱还债了！

“什么？跟弟弟做爱，我宁可去死！”

没办法，我只好拉来朋友金田，让这个不善交际的处男担任男演员。可我万万没想到，他竟然藏着一根真正的庞然大物！

……于是，这便成了一个悲伤弟弟为了偿还债务，不得不拍摄姐姐被朋友肆意享用的悲惨故事。
